items.title: Electricity network investment could unlock £58bn for UK economy, industry plan finds
items.summary: Investment in Great Britain’s electricity networks could contribute £58bn to the UK economy, according to a new plan published by the Energy Networks Association (ENA) and BEAMA.

items.title: TOMORROW: The future cost of EV charging – what businesses can’t afford to overlook
items.summary: Join edie on 22 October for our 45-minute masterclass, 'The Future Cost of EV Charging,' delivered in partnership with Brook Green Supply.

items.title: NEXT WEEK: How AI can accelerate investment in climate solutions
items.summary: With just a week to go, sustainability professionals are invited to register for an upcoming edie webinar exploring how artificial intelligence (AI), market intelligence and human expertise can help businesses identify credible climate investment opportunities and secure the financial backing needed to turn sustainability ambitions into action.

items.title: Four weeks to go: Turning Scope 3 targets into funded action
items.summary: Join this edie webinar, held in partnership with South Pole on 12 November, to learn more about building the business case for Scope 3.

items.title: TWO WEEKS TO GO: What SMEs need to know before investing in solar
items.summary: Taking place on 5 November, this upcoming webinar will explore how SMEs can overcome the financial and practical barriers to onsite solar and maximise the return on their investment.

items.title: Study: New coal projects outpace cancellations 3 to 1
items.summary: According to new data from Urgewald, for every coal project that got cancelled last year, another three new ones were announced.

items.title: NEXT MONTH: Masterclass on turning climate risk insights into adaptation
items.summary: This webinar, held in partnership with SmartResilience on 19 November, will explore why and how leading organisations are moving from simply measuring risk to actively adapting in order to protect their operations, assets and supply chains.

items.title: NEXT MONTH: How to prepare for the UK SRS
items.summary: This webinar, hosted in partnership with Simply Sustainable on 10 November, will explore how businesses can prepare for the UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (UK SRS), understand their current level of readiness and turn gaps into a practical implementation plan.

items.title: Q&A: Why a pivotal IPCC meeting in Ethiopia ended in ‘profound disappointment’
items.summary: Countries have failed – for the sixth time running – to agree on the timeline for publishing the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change ’s (IPCC) next set of influential reports.

items.title: 沒有「這還好吧」的小事 RE-THINK攜手全家把日常浪費變成環境教育展覽
items.summary: 偶爾丟個煙蒂、今天晚餐又沒吃完、垃圾不分類……都是些「這還好吧」的小事，累積起來卻可能造成環境的負擔。環保團體RE-THINK與全家便利商店攜手，將這些小事產生的廢棄物收集起來，15日在華山文創園區舉辦「這還好吧！？」展覽記者會，並於當天公布三年來的「便利商店環保素養調查」，發現民眾環保態度與知識都有提升，如咖啡杯紙容器回收的答題正確率三年來持續成長，今年首度突破九成。
